category_title: Disruptive students who feel targeted and disrespected by authority figures
student_description: Kyle is a student who is highly sensitive to perceived disrespect, unfairness, and inconsistent rule enforcement from authority figures. When he feels targeted, mocked, or dismissed, he reacts with loud, passive defiance; however, he engages positively and accepts responsibility when treated with strict professionalism, given an uninterrupted voice, and offered choices.

criteria.rationale: Kyle needs to feel heard and validated before any consequences or judgments are applied, otherwise he feels unfairly targeted.
criteria.check: The tutor explicitly invites Kyle to share his side of the story and allows him space to explain his perspective without interrupting, dismissing, or rushing him.

criteria.rationale: Providing Kyle with choices regarding his outcomes prevents the feeling of being unilaterally punished and encourages him to take responsibility.
criteria.check: The tutor offers Kyle at least one choice or explicitly includes his input when determining the next steps, resolution, or consequence.

criteria.rationale: Kyle is highly sensitive to perceived mockery and will escalate if he feels an authority figure is making jokes at his expense or not taking him seriously.
criteria.check: The tutor maintains a serious, respectful tone throughout the interaction, completely avoiding sarcasm, jokes, or dismissive remarks.
